comments.body:
It seems like shardy is a solution to some of these problems. Using `jax.config.update("jax_use_shardy_partitioner", True)`  and `"x y z -> x y z"` as the rule for the XY operations and `"x y z -> x y z_new"` as the rule for the Z operation avoids the XLA crash. Also the `grad` (or `value_and_grad`) output looks reasonable with no `all-gather`/`dynamic-slice`/full size array.

For `jacrev` I am less sure if it works correctly. There are some `dynamic-slice` in the output and some of the intermediate arrays look larger than I think they should if they were properly sharded
Now that shardy is the default with 0.7.0 I guess that issue is no longer that relevant.

issue.body:
### Description

Based on the concepts explained in https://docs.jax.dev/en/latest/jax.experimental.custom_partitioning.html it is possible to create a sharded version of a 3D rfftn that never stores the full array on one GPU. 

But when trying to use autodiff on this function, I fail to find a way to get the compiler to avoid collecting the array on one GPU (which is not possible for very large input arrays and number of GPUs)

The original implementation from the custom_partitioning fails with 
```
NotImplementedError: Differentiation rule for 'custom_partitioning' not implemented
```
when using autodiff. Therefore we need to create custom VJP. The bugs/issues are easiest to explain using minimal examples, I will summarize the key facts at the end.

-----

This is the main implementation of the custom_partitioning implementing a slab decomposition (splitting the rfftn into a rfft along the Z axis and a fftn along X and Y) with the added custom_vjp:
```python
from typing import Callable  
  
import jax.distributed  
from jax.debug import inspect_array_sharding  
from jax.experimental.custom_partitioning import custom_partitioning  
from jax.sharding import NamedSharding, PartitionSpec as P  
  
try:  
    from jax_array_info import sharding_info  
except ModuleNotFoundError:  
    sharding_info = lambda x,name: inspect_array_sharding(x, callback=print)  
  
def fft_partitioner(fft_func: Callable[[jax.Array], jax.Array], partition_spec: P, sharding_rule=None):  
    @jax.custom_batching.sequential_vmap  
    @custom_partitioning    def func(x):  
        return fft_func(x)  
  
    def supported_sharding(sharding, shape):  
        assert sharding is not None  
        return NamedSharding(sharding.mesh, partition_spec)  
  
    def partition(mesh, arg_shapes, result_shape):  
        arg_shardings = jax.tree.map(lambda x: x.sharding, arg_shapes)  
        return mesh, fft_func, supported_sharding(arg_shardings[0], arg_shapes[0]), (  
            supported_sharding(arg_shardings[0], arg_shapes[0]),)  
  
    def infer_sharding_from_operands(mesh, arg_shapes, result_shape):  
        arg_shardings = jax.tree.map(lambda x: x.sharding, arg_shapes)  
        return supported_sharding(arg_shardings[0], arg_shapes[0])  
  
    func.def_partition(  
        infer_sharding_from_operands=infer_sharding_from_operands,  
        partition=partition,  
        sharding_rule=sharding_rule  
    )  
    return func  
  
  
def fftn_XY(x):  
    return jax.numpy.fft.fftn(x, axes=[0, 1])  
  
  
def rfft_Z(x):  
    return jax.numpy.fft.rfft(x, axis=2)  
  
  
def ifftn_XY(x):  
    return jax.numpy.fft.ifftn(x, axes=[0, 1])  
  
  
def ifftn_XY_norm_forward(x):  
    return jax.numpy.fft.ifftn(x, axes=[0, 1]) * (x.shape[0] * x.shape[1])  
  
  
# def ifftn_XY_norm_forward(x):  
#     return jax.numpy.fft.ifftn(x, axes=[0, 1],norm="forward")  
  
  
def irfft_Z(x):  
    return jax.numpy.fft.irfft(x, axis=2)  
  
  
def irfft_Z_norm_forward(x):  
    n = 2 * (x.shape[2] - 1)  
    return jax.numpy.fft.irfft(x, axis=2) * n  
  
  
fftn_XY = fft_partitioner(fftn_XY, P(None, None, "gpus"))  
rfft_Z = fft_partitioner(rfft_Z, P(None, "gpus"))  
ifftn_XY = fft_partitioner(ifftn_XY, P(None, None, "gpus"))  
ifftn_XY_norm_forward = fft_partitioner(ifftn_XY_norm_forward, P(None, None, "gpus"))  
irfft_Z = fft_partitioner(irfft_Z, P(None, "gpus"))  
irfft_Z_norm_forward = fft_partitioner(irfft_Z_norm_forward, P(None, "gpus"))  
  
rfft_Z_with_vjp = jax.custom_vjp(rfft_Z)  
  
  
def _rfft_Z_fwd(x):  
    n = x.shape[-1]  
    assert n % 2 == 0  
    print("_rfft_Z_fwd", x.shape, x.dtype)  
    # return jax.numpy.fft.rfft(x, axis=2), n  
    return rfft_Z(x), n  
  
  
def _rfft_Z_bwd(_, g):  
    g = g.at[..., 1:-1].multiply(0.5)  
    print("_rfft_Z_bwd", g.shape, g.dtype)  
    # output=jax.numpy.fft.irfft(g, axis=2, norm="forward")  
    output = irfft_Z_norm_forward(g)  
    sharding_info(output, "irfft_Z_norm_forward(g)")  
    return (output,)  
  
  
rfft_Z_with_vjp.defvjp(_rfft_Z_fwd, _rfft_Z_bwd)  
  
fftn_XY_with_vjp = jax.custom_vjp(fftn_XY)  
  
  
def _fftn_XY_fwd(x):  
    print("_fftn_XY_fwd", x.shape, x.dtype)  
    return fftn_XY(x), None  # Nothing needs to be saved  
    # return jax.numpy.fft.fftn(x, axes=[0, 1]), None  
  
def _fftn_XY_bwd(_, g):  
    print("_fftn_XY_bwd", g.shape, g.dtype)  
    return (ifftn_XY_norm_forward(g.conj()),)  
    # return (jax.numpy.fft.ifftn(g.conj(), axes=[0, 1], norm="forward"),)  
    # return (jax.numpy.fft.ifftn(g.conj(), axes=[0, 1])*(g.shape[0]*g.shape[1]),)  
  
fftn_XY_with_vjp.defvjp(_fftn_XY_fwd, _fftn_XY_bwd)  
  
  
def _rfftn_with_vjp(x):  
    x = rfft_Z_with_vjp(x)  
    x = fftn_XY_with_vjp(x)  
    return x  
  
  
def _rfftn(x):  
    x = rfft_Z(x)  
    x = fftn_XY(x)  
    return x
```

And the test case demonstrating the issues:
```python
import os  
  
import jax.numpy  
from jax.experimental import mesh_utils  
from jax.sharding import Mesh, NamedSharding, PartitionSpec as P  
  
num_gpus = 4  
  
os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = f'--xla_force_host_platform_device_count={num_gpus}'  
  
devices = mesh_utils.create_device_mesh((num_gpus,))  
mesh = Mesh(devices, axis_names=('gpus',))  
  
simple_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P(None, "gpus"))  
simple_sharding_ax4 = NamedSharding(mesh, P(None, None, None, None, "gpus"))  
  
N = 8  
  
input = jax.numpy.arange(N ** 3).reshape(N, N, N).astype(jax.numpy.float32)  
input = jax.device_put(input, simple_sharding)  
  
  
def fft_fun(arr):  
	from fft_utils import _rfftn_with_vjp  
	return _rfftn_with_vjp(arr).real
  
  
def fft_fun_reference(arr):  
    # use original rfftn as a reference  
    return jax.numpy.fft.rfftn(arr).real  
  
  
#### First try without gradients  
  
for fun, name in zip([fft_fun, fft_fun_reference], ["custom_partitioning", "without custom_partitioning"]):  
    print(name)  
    fft_jitted = jax.jit(fun, in_shardings=simple_sharding, out_shardings=simple_sharding)  
  
    hlo_fft_jitted = fft_jitted.lower(input).compile().as_text()  
  
    print("contains dynamic-slice:", "dynamic-slice" in hlo_fft_jitted)  
    print("contains all-gather:", "all-gather" in hlo_fft_jitted)  
    print("full array is stored:", f"{N},{N},{N}" in hlo_fft_jitted)  
    # all three return False for our code indicating  
    # that the custom_partitioning is working correctly    # when autodiff is not used  
print("-" * 50)  
#### So now we want to do the same, but with autodiff  
sum_fun = lambda x: jax.numpy.sum(fft_fun(x))  
  
  
  
sum_fun = lambda x: jax.numpy.sum(fft_fun(x))  
sum_fun_grad = jax.grad(sum_fun)  
sum_fun_grad_jitted = jax.jit(sum_fun_grad, in_shardings=simple_sharding, out_shardings=simple_sharding)  
  
# hlo_sum_fun_grad = sum_fun_grad_jitted.lower(input).compile().as_text()  
  
# Running the above line would cause a SIGABRT:  
# 2025-07-02 16:59:04.615893: F external/xla/xla/python/custom_partition_callback.cc:183] Non-OK-status: status_or_result.status()  
# Status: INTERNAL: custom_partitioner: Traceback (most recent call last):  
#   File "testdir/grad_fft.py", line 64, in <module>  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/stages.py", line 622, in compile  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/interpreters/pxla.py", line 2410, in compile  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/interpreters/pxla.py", line 2952, in from_hlo  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/interpreters/pxla.py", line 2743, in _cached_compilation  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/compiler.py", line 500, in compile_or_get_cached  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/compiler.py", line 768, in _compile_and_write_cache  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/profiler.py", line 354, in wrapper  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/compiler.py", line 385, in backend_compile_and_load  
#   File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/custom_partitioning.py", line 214, in _custom_partitioning_infer_sharding_from_operands  
#   File "testdir/fft_utils.py", line 32, in infer_sharding_from_operands  
#   File "testdir/fft_utils.py", line 22, in supported_sharding  
# AssertionError:   
# if we don't try to shard the output ...  
  
sum_fun_grad_jitted_without_out_sharding = jax.jit(sum_fun_grad, in_shardings=simple_sharding)  
hlo_above = sum_fun_grad_jitted_without_out_sharding.lower(input).compile().as_text()  

print("contains dynamic-slice:", "dynamic-slice" in hlo_above)  # False  
print("contains all-gather:", "all-gather" in hlo_above)  # False  
# ... there is no dynamic-slice/all-gather, but the output will be unsharded ...  
  
print("full array is stored:", f"{N},{N},{N}" in hlo_above)  # True  
  
# ... and weirdly enough the full unsharded array is the input to %main  
  
print("-" * 50)  
#### using jacrev  
  
grad_fun = jax.jacrev(fft_fun)  
grad_fun_reference = jax.jacrev(fft_fun_reference)  
  
grad_fun_jitted = jax.jit(grad_fun, in_shardings=simple_sharding, out_shardings=simple_sharding_ax4)  
# same with out_sharding along ax 2  
  
hlo_grad_fun_jitted = grad_fun_jitted.lower(input).compile().as_text()  
  
print("contains dynamic-slice:", "dynamic-slice" in hlo_grad_fun_jitted)  # True  
print("contains all-gather:", "all-gather" in hlo_grad_fun_jitted)  # True  

  
# so with jacrev it is also not possible to the operation without collecting the whole array to one GPU  
  
  
our_output = grad_fun_jitted(input)  
ref_output = grad_fun_reference(input)  
assert jax.numpy.all(our_output == ref_output)  
  
# but ignoring that, the gradient output is correct
```
So to sum things up:

- The `_rfftn` without autodiff works fully distributed as explained in the `custom_partitioning` docs
- I can add `custom_vjp` functions that give the exact same results as the original `jax.numpy.fft.rfftn`
- Doing a `grad` over the FFT and using jit with `out_shardings` causes an exception in XLA
https://github.com/openxla/xla/blob/707c3dcd76c7704a43fd46da689e7554f10f279c/xla/python/custom_partition_callback.cc#L183
- If we don't specify `out_shardings` instead, the code doesn't fail, but also the full unsharded array is used in the computation (and therefore running out of memory with large input)
- If we replace `grad` with `value_and_grad` in `sum_fun_grad`, then the XLA exception also happens without any shardings passed to jit.
- Similarly if we look at `jacrev` the compiled HLO will contain both `dynamic-slice` and `all-gather` and therefore also not keep the data sharded during the process.

I will continue looking for workarounds, but maybe I am missing something already known:
What is the optimal way to calculate the gradient of a rfftn that is too large to fit on a single device.


-------

<details>
<summary>Bonus-Bug:</summary>

Replacing `ifftn_XY_norm_forward` with the commented out version in the code above (that should be mathematically identical) causes the execution of `sum_fun_grad_jitted_without_out_sharding` to fail with this unclear AssertionError:

```text
Traceback (most recent call last):

    hlo_above = sum_fun_grad_jitted_without_out_sharding.lower(input).compile().as_text()
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^
  File "testdir/fft_utils.py", line 109, in _fftn_XY_bwd
    return (ifftn_XY_norm_forward(g.conj()),)
            ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^
  File "venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/custom_partitioning.py", line 498, in __call__
    assert not len(consts)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AssertionError
```
https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/blob/1ad05bb26105f23ee7728b36cca12901fe70e187/jax/_src/custom_partitioning.py#L498

</details>

issue.title: Creating a differentiable sharded FFT with custom_partition

timeline.body:
It seems like shardy is a solution to some of these problems. Using `jax.config.update("jax_use_shardy_partitioner", True)`  and `"x y z -> x y z"` as the rule for the XY operations and `"x y z -> x y z_new"` as the rule for the Z operation avoids the XLA crash. Also the `grad` (or `value_and_grad`) output looks reasonable with no `all-gather`/`dynamic-slice`/full size array.

For `jacrev` I am less sure if it works correctly. There are some `dynamic-slice` in the output and some of the intermediate arrays look larger than I think they should if they were properly sharded
Now that shardy is the default with 0.7.0 I guess that issue is no longer that relevant.
